attributes.name: Ball of Twine
attributes.powers:
Recharge this card to summon and build the location Maze or Middle of Nowhere and move to it, or to move from one of those locations, ignoring movement restrictions.

When you attempt a check to defeat a monster that has the Minotaur trait, reveal this card to get a mythic charge.

corrections.corrected_text: On the item Torc of the Heavens and the loots Ball of Twine, Chalice of Ozem, and Dawnflower's Kiss, add the Mythic trait.
corrections.issue: Should all boons that reference mythic charges have the Mythic trait?
